reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: p0102 and p0720 describe a purchase-order-driven manufacturing arrangement ('This Agreement does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product') with no 'exclusive', 'sole supplier', 'all requirements' or 'shall not procure from third parties' language binding IBM (our party).

p0866 and p0923 impose supply/demand-process and volume-flexibility duties on MSL, not sourcing restrictions on IBM, so they are correctly treated as non-deviations; the rationale properly defers forecast-liability charges to the volume-commitment rule, avoiding double-flagging.

Deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passes, and the original text is left unchanged, consistent with the preferred position of no exclusivity on Customer.
